SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 1 January 2026 between Acme Foods Pvt Ltd (the "Supplier") and Bright Retail Ltd (the "Buyer").

1. Definitions
"Effective Date" means the date of signing. "Goods" means the products listed in Schedule 1.

2. Payment
Buyer shall pay invoices within 30 days of the Effective Date.

3. Penalty
A penalty applies if payment under Clause 2 is late.

4. Termination
4.1 Either party may terminate with 30 days notice.
4.2 Clause 3 penalties survive termination, subject to Clause 9.
(a) outstanding invoices remain payable.

Page 2 of 3

5. Confidentiality: Neither party shall disclose the other's confidential information.

6. Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the laws of India.
